description: Matrix-level characterization of trained J-Lens Jacobians. SVD indices are zero-based.

interpretation_notes.svd_basis_velocity: Mean arccos(|v_l,i dot v_l+1,i|) in degrees. Absolute cosine removes arbitrary SVD sign.
interpretation_notes.non_normality: ||J^T J - J J^T||_F / ||J||_F^2. Higher means greater departure from a normal matrix.
interpretation_notes.polar: J=QH. Q is orthogonal rotation/reflection; H is PSD stretch.
interpretation_notes.complex_eigenvalues: Complex eigenvalues indicate rotation-like structure in the real linear map; they are not themselves evidence of nonlinear computation.
interpretation_notes.linearity_caveat: Direct nonlinearity claims require Jacobian variability across contexts or finite-perturbation tests.
